title: Be a registered cat breeder
what: Breed cats only as a registered breeder or under a cat breeding permit.

sources.title: Cat Management Act 2009 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not breed a cat unless he or she – (a) is a registered breeder; or (b) holds a cat breeding permit in relation to the cat

administration.who: Secretary of the Department administering the Cat Management Act 2009 (Tas), or the council's general manager, who issue cat breeding permits

sources.title: Cat Management Act 2009 (Tas)
sources.locator: s 31, words naming the body (found 20 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: A person may apply to the Secretary, or to the general manager of the council for the municipal area in which the cat is situated, for a permit to breed a cat (a cat breeding permit ).
